title: DNA Extraction using FastDNA Spinkit for Soil with PolyA Modification
author: Tim D'angelo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ur8ev9w
materials: thaw out samples and polyA solution (4 ug/ul), get reagents from Fast DNA kit, turn on refrigerated centrifuge

steps.title: Prepare PolyA stock solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a stock solution of polyA in filter‑sterilized molecular‑grade water at 4 µg µL⁻¹ (adjust concentration as needed) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Add reagents to sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample into a tube and add 978 µL of SPB, 122 µL of MT buffer, and 64 µL of the PolyA solution (assuming a 4 µg µL⁻¹ stock).

steps.title: Homogenize sample
steps.instruction: Place the tube in the Retsch M400 shaker holder and shake at 30 r/s for 5 minutes to homogenize.

steps.title: Wash column with SEWS‑M
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of SEWS‑M solution to the spin filter, centrifuge (conditions as per kit), and discard the waste.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of DES to the filter column, incubate for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 14,000 g to collect the eluate.
